<strategy>
We aim to minimize the overlap integral $C_5$ by optimizing a piecewise constant function $h(x)$ on the interval $[0, 2]$. The function must satisfy the constraint $\int_0^2 h(x) dx = 1$. We use a gradient-based optimization approach with a small number of samples to keep it computationally feasible within the time budget. We start with the given initial guess and refine it using a numerical optimization routine to find a better upper bound for $C_5$.
</strategy>
